
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip rp2040` to volt.toml: chip = "rp2040"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip rp2040
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- HARDWARE ERROR -- main.volt:3[/red bold]

Pin 30 does not exist on RP2040. RP2040 has GP0-GP28.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]3 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 30
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Available pins: GP0-GP22, GP25-GP28[/cyan]
